open-doors.title: The first regulars
open-doors.body: Your sport now has {{fans, number}} fans in {{country}}, including {{hardcore, number}} hardcore followers. Decide what to build around: a welcoming first experience, or a stronger routine for the regulars.

first-following.title: A following of your own
first-following.body: {{country}} has reached the first audience milestone: {{fans, number}} people follow your sport. It is a small foothold, but it belongs to you.

league-arrival.title: Put it on the fixture list
league-arrival.body: A league formed in {{country}} during the last turn. There are {{hardcore, number}} hardcore fans here now. Another place where your sport has a home.

moving-up.title: A bigger stage
moving-up.body: You promoted the league in {{country}}. Its current level is {{tier}}, backed by {{hardcore, number}} hardcore fans. That step is now part of your sport's story.

local-airtime.title: An audience worth reaching
local-airtime.body: {{country}} now has {{fans, number}} fans. You have enough of a following to decide how to reach more people: invest in incoming media exposure or build connections with neighbouring markets.

crowded-sidelines.title: Bring them into the club
crowded-sidelines.body: {{fans, number}} people follow the sport in {{country}}, but only {{hardcore, number}} are hardcore. Turn some of that interest into commitment, or devote the attention to fundraising at the cost of new casual recruitment.

league-under-strain.title: A league under strain
league-under-strain.body: The league in {{country}} was rated {{health}} at the end of the turn. You can regroup at the cost of some hardcore commitment, invest in reaching new fans, or manage the underlying finances from Leagues.

rival-pushback.title: They have noticed
rival-pushback.body: {{rival}} increased its defensive attention in {{country}} during the last turn. Your sport has {{hardcore, number}} hardcore fans here. Challenge that rival's grip, or strengthen your own following.

season-champion.title: Champions of {{country}}
season-champion.body_european: {{champion}} won {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} of the {{country}} league, with {{runnerUp}} runners-up. Another name on the trophy, another chapter in the league's story.
season-champion.body_american: {{champion}} beat {{runnerUp}} in the final to win {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} of the {{country}} league. Another name on the trophy, another chapter in the league's story.

season-foregone.title: A foregone league
season-foregone.body: {{champion}} have now won {{streak}} titles in a row in {{country}}. Casual fans are already drifting away from a result they can predict. A draft lottery would weaken the champions and lift the rest of the field.

season-runaway.title: Runaway champions
season-runaway.body_one: {{champion}} won {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} in {{country}} {{count, number}} point clear of {{runnerUp}}. Casual fans tuned out long before the end. Sharing revenue would strengthen the rest of the field.
season-runaway.body_other: {{champion}} won {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} in {{country}} {{count, number}} points clear of {{runnerUp}}. Casual fans tuned out long before the end. Sharing revenue would strengthen the rest of the field.

choices.hold: Leave the money where it is

season-dynasty.title: A dynasty
season-dynasty.body: {{champion}} have won {{streak}} titles in a row in {{country}}. Celebrate them and the faithful grow, though casual fans tire of a result they can call in advance. Level the field and the champions' supporters will resent it.

season-repeat-final.title: The same two again
season-repeat-final.body_european: For the second {{seasonNoun}} running, {{champion}} and {{runnerUp}} finished first and second in {{country}}, with {{champion}} on top this time. A rivalry is forming. Stoke it and the hardcore will love it, though the league's finances may suffer.
season-repeat-final.body_american: For the second {{seasonNoun}} running, {{champion}} and {{runnerUp}} met in the final in {{country}}, and {{champion}} won it this time. A rivalry is forming. Stoke it and the hardcore will love it, though the league's finances may suffer.

season-underdog.title: Against the odds
season-underdog.body: {{champion}} began {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} among the weakest clubs in {{country}} and finished as champions, ahead of {{runnerUp}}. Ride the story to win new fans, or invest in the club so it can stay competitive.

season-first-title.title: A first title
season-first-title.body: {{champion}} won the first title in their history in {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} in {{country}}, ahead of {{runnerUp}}. Use the moment to reach new people, or reward the supporters who were there before it.

season-close-finish.title: Down to the wire
season-close-finish.body_european_zero: {{champion}} and {{runnerUp}} finished level on points at the top in {{country}}, and {{champion}} took {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} on score difference. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_european_one: Only {{count, number}} point separated {{champion}} from {{runnerUp}} at the end of {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} in {{country}}. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_european_other: Only {{count, number}} points separated {{champion}} from {{runnerUp}} at the end of {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} in {{country}}. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_american: {{champion}} beat {{runnerUp}} in the final of {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} in {{country}} by the narrowest of margins. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_deciders: The final of {{seasonNoun}} {{season}} in {{country}} finished level and went to deciders, and {{champion}} came through against {{runnerUp}}. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.

star-breakout.title: A star is born
star-breakout.body_one: {{player}} scored {{count, number}} time in {{matches, number}} {{matchNoun}} for {{club}} in {{seasonNoun}} {{season}}: {{share, number(style: percent)}} of the club's {{scoresNoun}}. The league has a new star.
star-breakout.body_other: {{player}} scored {{count, number}} times in {{matches, number}} {{matchNoun}} for {{club}} in {{seasonNoun}} {{season}}: {{share, number(style: percent)}} of the club's {{scoresNoun}}. The league has a new star.

star-final-season.title: One last {{seasonNoun}}
star-final-season.body_one: {{player}} of {{club}} will retire after next {{seasonNoun}}. They have scored {{count, number}} time in {{seasons, number}} {{seasonsNoun}}, and fans want to see them play while they can.
star-final-season.body_other: {{player}} of {{club}} will retire after next {{seasonNoun}}. They have scored {{count, number}} times in {{seasons, number}} {{seasonsNoun}}, and fans want to see them play while they can.

star-retired.title: A star retires
star-retired.body_one: {{player}} has played their last {{matchOne}} for {{club}}. They retire with {{count, number}} {{scoreNoun}} in {{matches, number}} {{matchNoun}} over {{seasons, number}} {{seasonsNoun}}.
star-retired.body_other: {{player}} has played their last {{matchOne}} for {{club}}. They retire with {{count, number}} {{scoreNoun}} in {{matches, number}} {{matchNoun}} over {{seasons, number}} {{seasonsNoun}}.

star-moved.title: A star changes clubs
star-moved.body: {{player}} has left {{otherClub}} for {{club}}, a stronger side. Stars go where they can win.

star-record.title: A league record
star-record.body_one: {{player}} of {{club}} is now the {{country}} league's all-time top scorer, with {{count, number}} {{scoreNoun}}.
star-record.body_other: {{player}} of {{club}} is now the {{country}} league's all-time top scorer, with {{count, number}} {{scoreNoun}}.

star-succession.title: A backed star's last {{seasonNoun}}
star-succession.body: {{player}} of {{club}}, a star you back, will retire after next {{seasonNoun}}. Retire them with honors and their influence fades slowly instead of stopping, or let them go.
star-succession.body_mentor: {{player}} of {{club}}, a star you back, will retire after next {{seasonNoun}}. Retire them with honors and their influence fades slowly instead of stopping, or let them mentor {{candidate}}, who would take on part of it.

star-keep.title: A backed star wants to move
star-keep.body: {{player}} wants to leave {{otherClub}} for {{club}}, a stronger side. Your backing goes with them. The league can pay to keep them where they are.

star-dropped.title: Fans remember
star-dropped.body: Supporters have not forgiven you for dropping {{player}}. Casual interest in {{country}} is cooling.

rival-reclaim.title: They want their fans back
rival-reclaim.body: {{rival}} is winning back the terraces in {{country}}. With your sport near the top of the world, it is turning some of your {{hardcore, number}} hardcore fans here back to its own game, season by season.

rival-championship.title: The world tunes in to {{rival}}
rival-championship.body: This year belongs to {{tournament}}. For a year {{rival}} pulls new fans in every country, even in {{country}}, before the excitement fades.

events.seasonScorer_one: {{player}} was the {{seasonNoun}}'s top scorer, with {{count, number}} {{scoreNoun}}.
events.seasonScorer_other: {{player}} was the {{seasonNoun}}'s top scorer, with {{count, number}} {{scoreNoun}}.

rulebook.heading: Rulebook
rulebook.founded: {{sport}} was founded in {{year}} in {{place}}, {{country}}. Its first club, {{club}}, plays at {{ground}}.

ethos.gentlemans-game: It is a gentleman's game: fair play is spoken of more than winning.
ethos.working-class-game: It is a working-class game, played after shifts and paid for in coins.
ethos.rebel-game: It is a rebel game, loved partly because the respectable disapprove.
ethos.family-game: It is a family game: three generations stand on the same touchline.

surface.grass: It is played outdoors on grass.
surface.indoor: It is played indoors, on a hard court.
surface.street: It is played on the street, on whatever tarmac is free.

equipment.ball-only: It needs nothing but a ball.
equipment.stick-or-bat: Players carry a stick or bat, and there is a ball.
equipment.protective-gear: Players wear protective gear, and there is a ball.

physical.speed: Speed wins more than anything else.
physical.precision: Precision matters more than pace or power.
physical.endurance: The fittest side usually wins in the end.

footprint.medium: The playing area is of middling size.

contact.none: Contact between players is not allowed.
contact.incidental: Contact is incidental and penalized when it is not.
contact.full: Full contact is part of the game.

matchLength.long: A {{match}} is long, sometimes very long.

complexity.simple: The rules fit on a postcard.
complexity.moderate: The rules take an afternoon to learn.
complexity.intricate: The rules are intricate; arguments about them are part of the fun.

structure.stop-start: Play stops and starts in set pieces.
structure.innings: Sides take turns to attack and defend, in innings.

odd.ice-innings: Innings on ice are slow, cold and, to their admirers, perfect.
odd.street-large-field: A large field on the street means closing several roads; councils are rarely consulted.
odd.indoor-large-field: Few halls are big enough, so most matches are played in aircraft hangars.
odd.full-contact-precision: Precision under full contact is admired and rarely achieved.
odd.ice-long-match: Long matches on ice are played in layers of wool.
odd.small-team-large-field: Small sides on a large field do a great deal of running.
odd.large-team-small-field: Large sides on a small field leave little room to move.
odd.gear-no-contact: Players wear protective gear in a game without contact, just in case.
odd.ice-marathon: An endurance game on ice, played long: spectators are advised to bring soup.

diagram.heading: The field
diagram.label: Field diagram: {{surface}}, a {{size}} field, {{count, number}} players a side.

rules.heading: Amend the rules
rules.intro: Once a year, in the seasonal window, you may change one rule. Purists push back: some hardcore fans turn casual, more the older the rule, the bigger the change, in {{anchor}}, and where the old rule suited fans better.
rules.closed: Rules can be amended only in the seasonal window.
rules.done: The rules have been amended this year. The next amendment waits for next year's window.
rules.open: The seasonal window is open: you may amend one rule this year.
